risks: Supplier cost is weak: the Rs 200 TradeIndia item is a generic 'decorative metal wind chime', not confirmed as a copper-coated 5-bell chime; if priced per bell (Rs 150-185 each, IndiaMART) a 5-bell chime would fail the margin rule
Possible overlap with brass bells (already dropped); this is copper-coated hand-forged iron, a different craft and material, but the reviewer should confirm it is not treated as a repeat

Rs 849 sits between iTokri's Rs 650-690 chimes and its Rs 1,290 5-bell chime; a buyer comparing with Rs 650 iTokri listings may resist, so Rs 849 needs a larger or more ornate chime than the Rs 650 ones
Supplier in Gujarat, so website-only under docs/05 (no Odisha supplier found)
Do not describe as 'copper bells' or 'pure copper': these are iron with a copper/brass coating; any material claim needs supplier evidence
Iron core can rust if hung outdoors or in coastal humidity (Odisha); returns risk if not disclosed; recommend 'indoor/covered verandah' wording
Not glass and not fragile, but bells can dent or bend in transit and cords can tangle; rigid box and wrapping needed
GST assumed 12% (HSN 8306 bells/ornaments of base metal; may now be 5% or 18% after Sept 2025 rationalisation); CA to confirm
Weight not stated for a chime; a single bell is 150 g, so 5 bells plus hanger assumed under 1 kg packed; needs a weighed sample

review.notes: No hard-rule breach and not undercut on present evidence (no Amazon.in/Flipkart/Meesho 5-bell Kutch chime with a price at or below Rs 500 found on 2026-11-24), and copper-coated hand-forged iron is a different craft from the dropped brass bells, so not a repeat. But the same 5-bell Kutch chime sells at Rs 650 at specialists (Zishta Danti, iTokri), at Rs 649 the margin fails even at Rs 200 cost (28.5%), and at Rs 849 it fails once supplier cost reaches about Rs 305 (Rs 400 -> 16.7%) while the only exact cost evidence is per bell (Rs 150-185 each), so a written single-piece drop-ship quote under Rs 300 for a larger/ornate 5-bell design that justifies Rs 849 is required; reject if either fails.
